data.description:
A lone wanderer on the edge of space, a mystery as old as the universe itself, and one little robot who just wants to make the tea.

**Into Black** is a First-Person action adventure that takes you into the depths of a mysterious alien planet. Explore the endless darkness, mine valuable resources, and fight off alien beasts as you try to repair your ship and escape.

{1177670523327594}

Designed for Meta Quest and leveraging the power of Quest 3, featuring a rich story, multiple game modes, and solo or co-op gameplay.

# Features
- **Single or Co-op action:** Play the entire campaign with up to 3 friends, or just jump in for an epic solo adventure.

- **Fight to survive:** Deadly alien creatures lurk in the darkness; to survive you'll have to master an array of powerful weapons.

{550964510785172}

- **Fully voice-acted campaign:** Follow deep space scavenger Ben Mitchell and his hapless assistant droid as they are drawn into a mystery at the heart of the universe.

- **Explore 20+ levels across multiple unique biomes:** Navigate magma chambers, sunken caves, labyrinthine tunnels, alien nests, and more. 

- **Gather resources & upgrade tools:** Mine, scavenge and loot as you gather the resources you need to upgrade your character and repair your ship. 

{507022245462960}

- **"Singularity" PvPvE mode:** Face off against up to 11 other players in this online competitive mode. Forge uneasy alliances as you navigate an ever-shrinking maze. Gather as much loot as you can, but get too greedy and you may not make it out at all…

{1888508874972980}

changelog.change_log:
Into Black - Patch #1
v 1.1.01.261.2410141809

Improvements:

*   Balance pass on resource cost amounts
*   More intense teleport extraction fights
*   General combat and enemy AI improvements
*   Improved late game boss encounters
*   Golem now has better hand-eye coordination
*   Pickaxe throwing refinements
*   Added gyros to later levels
*   Boosted enemy health at higher difficulties
*   Improved Quest 2 stability

Audio:

*   New player level up SFX
*   New tool level up SFX
*   New teleport beacon SFX
*   New hive extractor SFX
*   Improved UI hover SFX
*   Resource impact improvements

Bug Fixes:

*   Fixed sequencing issues around the Mission 3 anomaly, can now breach / scan in any order and it shouldn't break
*   Fixed issue where some schematics were not dropping correctly (upgrades for health, grenades etc)
*   Fixed issue with some upgrades not displaying correctly in skill tree
*   Fixed orb drops not occurring on some enemy variants
*   Fixed Sticky Flares not working
*   Fixed a bug where damage numbers didn't show on hammer throws
*   Fixed a bug where golem would lose aggro after player death
*   Optimized boss music and reduced likelihood of start/stops
*   Fixed an issue where some impact sounds were using the ship hull surface instead of body
*   Fixed icon orientation in fabricator
*   Repairing the drive core now visually repairs it in the ship
*   Fixed wrist UI bug where pickaxe could disappear
*   Fixes for final boss room fog
*   Correctly un-hover devices in the objectives tab, stopping them from stealing crafting input when not focused (Breacher ghost crafting fix)
*   Fixed chest game not allowing minimum contraction and fixed pop delay
*   Fixed shark(s) not spawning
*   Fixed player level cap (now correctly capping at 20)
*   Fixed several instances of 'floating' resources
*   Several cave and ship lighting fixes

QoL Improvements:

*   Schematics at the fabricator now clearly display which tool/weapon the upgrade is for
*   Added tooltips to recipe ingredients in the fabricator
*   Added inline crafting to recipe ingredients that have their own recipes in the fabricator
*   Colored material owned shown in red if not enough for recipe fabrication
*   Added Upgrade Terminal ‘Help’ button with Tutorial
*   Added ‘whip to platform’ schematic to Mission 5 cave
*   Add non-head based movement options
*   Increased the range of the teleport arc in anomaly to help navigate more easily
*   Made the vortex sphere pop-up more informative
*   Added extractor warning when players are attempting to leave before the mission objective is complete
*   Added menu option to throw pickaxe with grip
*   Loading tip updates with more useful information

Misc:

*   Reduced laser wasp health
*   Various VO additions and tweaks
*   Added credits to options menu
*   Prevented XP gain on minables that you can't damage
*   Updated pistol texture


Join the Into Black community on Discord at https://discord.gg/intoblack
